about: Cases in plan/cases/ the engine does not meet yet, each with the live plan item that will meet it (plan/decisions/2026-11-01-parity-cases-gaps.md). That item adds the case's parity test here and removes its entry.

gaps.why: the host loads the workflow named on each call and pins no workflow or file hash at filing
no handler carries out the stop effect, so a left card stays up, and quick-fix takes no event for its PR merged by another path
offer() runs the item's open effects whoever owns it, so another session's host posts the owner's pending card
awaitingMerge and replanning set no timer, so no wake is scheduled for an item waiting on a card
